items.proposed: keep row: other (pS6 IHC positivity), eligibility, candidate_matched true, temsirolimus
items.reason: Inclusion requires "Tissue must demonstrate mTOR+: ... OR pS6 positivity on immunohistochemistry (≥30% for pS6)"; pS6 is a distinct alternative entry marker of mTOR pathway activation matched to the mTOR inhibitor temsirolimus. Listing it separately (coder B) is consistent with one row per biomarker; the primary outcome is true either way via the PTEN_PI3K row.

note: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0): translational subset only, not the primary estimand. Intra-arterial delivery coded new_route, not device_dependent (agreed). D31-A2 considered: every mTOR+ route (PTEN/PI3K alterations or pS6 IHC) is an mTOR-pathway marker, so mTOR+ is a required entry status and the rows count. cns5 consistent with D31-B4 ("Grade 3 or 4 per 2021 WHO criteria").
